nuggets.text: David Blough made his first NFL start as a Lions quarterback on Thanksgiving Day 2019, years before calling plays for the Commanders.
Commanders offensive coordinator David Blough is the brother-in-law of NFL cornerback Christian Gonzalez.
Dan Quinn often wears his cap backwards during games, a habit he started while on the Cowboys' coaching staff.
Sonny Styles got his nickname from Sonny Corleone of The Godfather, courtesy of his dad, after childhood tantrums at his brother.
Rookie Sonny Styles is the only player his size since 2003 to run a sub-4.5 40, jump 40-plus inches and broad jump 11-plus feet.
Jayden Daniels became the first starting NFL quarterback with Japanese ancestry since Arthur Matsu in 1928.
Terry McLaurin has a cereal named after him: Terry McLaurin's Crunch Time.
Laremy Tunsil became the first offensive lineman in NFL history to earn $30 million per season.
The Commanders won their last trip to Philadelphia, 24-17, on January 4, 2026.
Major Tuddy, the Commanders' pig mascot, is named for 'TD' and honors the Hogs, Washington's famed 1980s offensive line.
